# Bitnami Secure Image for elasticsearch-exporter

This image is no longer available for free through Docker Hub. This image is available as a built OCI artifact in both Debian and Photon base OS formats through a commercial subscription of Bitnami Secure Images. However, there are still other Bitnami Secure Images available as developer editions on Docker Hub. For a complete list of those, [visit the public catalog](https://app-catalog.vmware.com/bitnami/apps) and filter by _Availability Type: Trial_.

We recommend considering the benefits of upgrading from the prior generation of Debian images to the Photon-based Bitnami Secure Images. They are fully compatible with the same popular Helm charts as the original Debian images. By upgrading, users will benefit from:
- Hardened secure images of popular open source software with Near-Zero Vulnerabilities
- Vulnerability Triage & Prioritization with VEX Statements, KEV and EPSS Scores
- Compliance focus with FIPS, STIG, and air-gap options, including secure bill of materials (SBOM)
- Software supply chain provenance attestation through in-toto
- First class support for the internet’s favorite Helm charts

Learn more about the [commercial Bitnami Secure Images offering by visiting our website](https://bitnami.com/).
